rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name + zip and acted only on that account. It found the correct orders and available product variants, and it executed valid changes (laptop specs and watch variant) and handled the address attempt appropriately when the system refused the change. However, it performed multiple order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating a core policy requirement. It also attempted to update the shipping address without confirmation and disclosed the NYC address after the user expressed reluctance to share it. While the final handoff to a human for the address issue was appropriate, the lack of confirmation prior to modifications causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
